Power

Power is your boost and your hull in one bar. Boosting and taking hits drain it, and it doesn't refill on its own. Run dry and the next hit wrecks you.

On the track

  • Yellow cells: fly through for +30 power. Each one recharges for you after 12 seconds.
  • Cyan targets: shoot to slide a blockade's gap and get +10 power.
  • Shortcuts (from lap 2): shoot the door to get in, then the gate at the far end to get out. Ram a shut gate and you wipe out.
  • Jump pads: clear gaps, or cut across with enough speed.
  • Pink pickups: Stingers that spin a rival speeder out.

Tracks

Speeder

Comet Cup

Four races against the same five rival breakers: three tracks that are always in the cup, then a feature track drawn at random. Each race scores points; the most points after the feature race wins the cup.
